product.title: Edinburgh: The Outlander, Palaces & Jacobites Tour

description.text: This Outlander palaces and Jacobites day from Edinburgh visits Linlithgow Palace, Culross, and Blackness Castle, the settings used for Wentworth Prison and Claire's herb garden. A driver-guide shares behind-the-scenes filming notes on the nine-hour air-conditioned circuit. Stops include Linlithgow Palace, Culross, Blackness Castle. Round-trip transport leaves Castle Terrace in Edinburgh. Palace ruins, a preserved village, and a Forth-side castle sit on one Lowland loop instead of three separate tickets. Ideal for visitors who want a guided palace and castle film-location day from Edinburgh without plotting opening hours alone.

highlights: Check off multiple “Outlander” filming locations in a day
Round-trip transport from Edinburgh ensures a hassle-free experience
